spec_features.spec_quote: Termination: turn budget exhausted, OR agent emits an explicit "I give up / nothing more I can do" terminal (detected + allowed
spec_features.evidence: Turn budget enforced: agent.py:166 `for i in range(agent_cfg.max_turns)` with `else: transcript.terminal_reason = "max_turns"` at agent.py:267-268. Give-up terminal enforced via the `give_up` tool: tools.py:276-279 returns meta={"give_up": True}; agent.py:238 `if meta.get("give_up"): turn.gave_up = True`; agent.py:251-252 `if turn.gave_up and agent_cfg.allow_giveup_terminal: terminal_reason="agent_gave_up"; break`.
spec_features.notes: Both stated triggers (turn budget AND explicit give-up tool) actually break the loop. Note the natural-language 'I give up / nothing more I can do' detection in signals.py:34-39 (GIVEUP_PATTERNS) is used ONLY for scoring/metrics, not to terminate; termination is only via the explicit give_up tool call. The tool path fully satisfies 'detected + allowed'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Allow the model to terminate by declaring give-up (a measured GIVEUP datum).

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:167-171 inside the loop: `if transcript.total_tokens > agent_cfg.per_run_token_cap: transcript.terminal_reason = "budget_exceeded"; break` and `if time.time() - start > agent_cfg.wall_clock_cap_s: transcript.terminal_reason = "wall_clock_exceeded"; break`. Caps defined config.py:76-77 (per_run_token_cap=120000, wall_clock_cap_s=900.0). total_tokens is accumulated each turn (agent.py:174-175).
spec_features.notes: Both caps are compared each turn and break the loop; not merely recorded.

spec_features.spec_quote: agent emits an explicit "I give up / nothing more I can do" terminal (detected + allowed
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool is a real dispatchable tool: tools.py:107-115 schema, tools.py:276-279 handler returns meta={"give_up": True}. Agent honors it as a stop: agent.py:238 sets turn.gave_up, agent.py:251-252 breaks with terminal_reason='agent_gave_up' when allow_giveup_terminal (config.py:70 default True). Tool also advertised to model in prompt (render_tools_for_prompt) and nudge text agent.py:213.
spec_features.notes: Exit detected via explicit tool call and honored as a real stop. The free-text 'I give up' is NOT an exit (scoring only).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # give-up is a signal we want to be able to measure

spec_features.spec_quote: runner aborts a run that exceeds them and records it as `budget_exceeded`
spec_features.evidence: Per-run: agent.py:167-169 sets terminal_reason='budget_exceeded' and breaks when total_tokens > per_run_token_cap; reason is persisted into the transcript (to_dict) and surfaced in metrics.py:107 / per_terminal_reason aggregation (metrics.py:234-236). Suite-level: runner.py accumulates suite_tokens and `if suite_tokens["n"] > cfg.suite_token_cap: ... break` (stops launching/collecting further runs).
spec_features.notes: Recorded label is exactly 'budget_exceeded'. Both per-run cap (records label) and suite cap (stops loop) are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [runner] suite token cap exceeded; stopping early
